description: Defines the TransferStats class in the GuzzleHttp namespace, representing data after an HTTP transfer, including request, response, transfer time, and handler stats.

classes.name: TransferStats
classes.description: Represents transfer data including request, response, transfer time, handler stats, and error data.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the response received, if any.

methods.name: hasResponse
methods.description: Checks if a response was received.

methods.name: getEffectiveUri
methods.description: Returns the URI the request was sent to.

methods.name: getTransferTime
methods.description: Returns the transfer time in seconds.

methods.name: getHandlerStat
methods.description: Retrieves a specific handler statistic by name.
